heartbeat_note: last_write_ts = collector wrote the local CSV row; last_push_ts = that row was pushed to this mirror; push_status = OK|STALE|FAILED. When last_write_ts advances but last_push_ts does not, the break is the PUSH, not the collector — mirror-stale is then self-evident, not inferred. Consumers (build_trade_state.py heartbeat, engine_freshness_guard) judge these against the WALL CLOCK, never against the anchored reference clock.
reader_note: pushed_at = real data row time; reader must treat as STALE if old vs its clock.
